claim: The nosepiece holds six objectives and its positions are numbered from zero: 0 through 5, not 1 through 6. Any command or preflight check that assumes 1 through 6 is off by one on every position.

numbers.name: nosepiece_positions
numbers.note: a count of slots, exact; the index base is 0, which is not a number but part of the claim

validity_conditions: This instrument as configured on 2026-09-17, operator read at the instrument. The count is separate from which lens sits in which position (nosepiece_objective_assignment) on purpose: a lens swap falsifies the assignment and leaves the count standing. Falsified by fitting or removing a turret.
